name: bounded-pi-adapter-loader
description: Loader shim: pi discovers extensions ONLY by scanning ~/.pi/agent/extensions/ (direct files, or a subdirectory whose package.json declares 'pi.extensions'). The adapter itself lives in hosts/pi/extensions/ (ADR 2026-035); this manifest is the one pointer the scan finds, and each path resolves to the adapter's real files so imports stay rooted there. A drift test (hosts/pi/discovery.test.ts) pins this list to the directory's contents.
